articles.title: BoM forecasts strongest El Niño on record as research points to ‘alarming’ climate change influence
articles.description:
Bureau of Meteorology suggests El Niño has already broken records, with Pacific Ocean temperature change exceeding 2C in six months

  • Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates

  • Sign up for climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s free Clear Air newsletter here

The growing El Niño weather phenomenon to Australia’s east is already breaking heat records, with forecasts showing it may easily surpass previous events, according to Australia’s Bureau of Meteorology.

Separate research suggests climate change has greatly shortened the odds of the event hitting record extremes.

articles.title: Range Rover launches its first electric vehicle, with starting price of £154,070
articles.description:
Fully electric SUV unveiled after year-long delay and will be built at Jaguar Land Rover’s plant in Solihull

Range Rover has launched its first electric vehicle – a year later than planned – offering a greener option for fans of gargantuan British-made SUVs who are also conscious about the climate crisis.

Due to be built in Solihull, the home of the marque since 1970, the vehicle comes with an eye-watering price tag, starting at £154,070.
